title: [Infographic] Plastics export ban begins: How much more of EU’s 22 million tonne per year trash mountain will go into landfills?
lede: With record plastic waste and shrinking recycling capacity, Europe’s new export ban risks quietly diverting mountains of rubbish into incinerators, landfills and poorer neighbours’ backyards.
